title: Selling Presets Without Stripe: What Nobody Tells You Before You Choose — No Stripe Required
author: COREMERCH
excerpt: Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy block creators in dozens of countries. Here is the sovereign infrastructure that works everywhere they do not.

content.text: Every creator in a platform-restricted country eventually arrives at the same moment: the application rejected, the payout held, the account flagged for no stated reason. Stripe does not support your country. PayPal's compliance engine decided your location is high-risk. Gumroad cannot pay you because Stripe cannot move the money. These are not bugs. They are the architecture working exactly as designed — for a specific set of markets, and against yours. The correct response is not to appeal, not to find a workaround, and not to use a friend's account in another country. The correct response is to build infrastructure that does not depend on their permission to operate. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront. NOWPayments verifies payments on-chain and fires a webhook the moment a transaction confirms. Your backend processes the order and delivers the product automatically. No platform involved. No permission required.
What Each Option Actually Offers

Traditional platforms like Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy offer ease of use and a wide range of features, but their geographical restrictions and dependency on platforms like Stripe limit their usefulness for creators in certain regions. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure solutions provide a base-layer alternative, enabling creators to own their entire sales stack and operate independently of restricted platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad's payout delays, Payhip's withdrawal restrictions, and Lemon Squeezy's geographic unavailability all stem from the same root cause: these platforms operate within the traditional financial system. They process payments through Stripe or PayPal on the backend, which means they inherit every restriction those processors impose. When Stripe does not support your country, Gumroad cannot pay you out — regardless of what the platform's feature list implies. Paddle operates as a merchant of record, which creates additional compliance requirements that make it functionally unavailable in most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not platform-level problems. They are financial system problems that only infrastructure built outside that system can solve.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction. It monitors the blockchain in real time. When payment confirms on-chain, it fires a webhook to your configured endpoint automatically. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure provides creators with full ownership and control over their sales stack.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The asymmetric risk of platform dependency becomes concrete only when the platform acts. While a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When it stops functioning — through suspension, policy change, or geographic restriction enforcement — the creator loses their revenue channel instantly, often with funds already inside the platform that cannot be withdrawn. The conventional appeals process rarely reverses these decisions because the original decision was made algorithmically and the human review process operates on the platform's timeline and criteria, not yours. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this asymmetry entirely. Your Cloudflare Pages storefront cannot be suspended by a payment processor's compliance team. Your wallet cannot be frozen by anyone.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Your backend experience is complete visibility through a transaction log and order management system. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution. That independence is the solution — not a workaround inside the system that excluded you, but an entirely different system.
NOWPayments offers a 0.5% fee per transaction, significantly reducing costs for creators.
